summary: Full end-to-end testing of restocking.app landing site (Next.js 16 App Router + FastAPI/Mongo). All 8 backend pytest cases pass and every UI test passed. Tested: 6 page routes return 200 with correct page-level data-testid; hero waitlist happy path (success message visible) and error path (invalid email error visible); pricing toggle (€59 default annual → €7.99 monthly → €59 annual); FAQ accordion (item-0 open by default, item-1 reveals on click); locale switcher (FR labels Accueil/Comment ça marche/Marques/Tarifs/FAQ/Manifesto, EN labels Home/How it works/Stores/Pricing/FAQ/Manifesto, locale persists to /pricing); header nav links present; footer links + site-logo present; mobile (390x844) hides primary-nav and reveals mobile-nav with all 6 mobile-nav-* links on toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: waitlist_stats() has a stale comment about adding a base offset, but the offset (+137) actually lives in the frontend live-counter. Comment is misleading — consider removing.

server.py: EMAIL_RE is custom and used to validate, while the Pydantic model WaitlistEntry uses EmailStr but the incoming WaitlistSignupIn uses plain str. This works but creates two sources of truth for email validation. Consider switching WaitlistSignupIn.email to EmailStr or document why custom regex is preferred (likely to control the 400 response format).
server.py: The `existing` branch computes `total = await db.waitlist.count_documents({})` but never returns it (the variable is unused). Dead code — can be removed.
server.py is a single-file backend ~130 lines, well within limits. No DRY/file-size concerns.
Frontend correctly uses NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from .env for all API calls; every interactive element has a data-testid as required.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on landing site
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ waitlist entries via random emails in pytest and UI flows. No cleanup performed (waitlist is append-only and emails are uniquely random, so no collision risk).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py covers /api/health, /api/waitlist (valid, duplicate, invalid, FR/EN locale messages), /api/waitlist/stats. Run via: NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist.py -v. All landing-site data-testid hooks resolve. The /login /signup /(dashboard) scaffolding routes were intentionally not tested per request. Locale-switcher uses localStorage key 'restocking.locale' and survives navigation. Pricing default is annual.
